crossRefs.note: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to…
But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
Sell that which you have, and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in…
When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to…
If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you…
Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.
He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.
There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains…
The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh; he will reward him.
There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.
He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me to the east gate of Yahweh’s house, which looks eastward. Behold…
He said to me, “Son of man, these are the men who devise iniquity, and who give wicked counsel in this city;
Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry, and that you bring the poor who are cast out to your house? When you…
When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (even though eyes see no…
Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you…
Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.
Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may…
If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to…
Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

translations.web: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.
translations.bsb: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what is yours, do not demand it back.
translations.kjv: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
translations.asv: Give to every one that asketh thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
